ui_bugs.issue: Submit button 'Gabungkan' at bottom-right of Customer 360 is overlapped by the floating 'Bantuan & Panduan / Smart Guidelines' tutorial popover. Playwright had to click via JS to bypass pointer-event interception. Real users on default/first-time view may also face click obstruction. Suggest closing/dismissing tutorial overlay or raising z-index of section-card action area.

After creating a new session, cc-add-product-select (KNSelect) opens options but clicking the first option via [role=option] did not persist the selection and cc-add-item-button adds 0 items (verified with new session TEST_P18 CC Reopen cc_8bab54278650 — 0 items). This may be a KNSelect pop state/transition issue. Reproducible by Playwright click force=True on [role=option].

issues: After switching entity via header switcher, URL loses the ?entity param (becomes ?view=admin-home) but UI/data still correctly scoped. Expected behavior per spec: '?entity tetap & data ter-scope.' — URL does NOT preserve the entity query param after switch (only data does, via localStorage/state). This is a UX/spec mismatch — explicit copy-link sharing of the Kanda-scoped page would still show Sukacita default unless ?entity is appended manually.

critical_code_review_comments: VendorBillPayments.jsx uses window.prompt() for void reason — works but is non-stylable and inconsistent with the rest of the app that uses askReason/confirm-modal. Consider switching to the same confirm-modal-reason flow used elsewhere (e.g. GRN discrepancy resolution) for consistency.
CustomerMergeSection.jsx submit sends {data:{source_id, reason}} — the double 'data' wrapper is unusual; verify alignment with backend DTO.
AUTH-06: Entity switcher should preserve ?entity param in the URL after switch (route param drift means deep links won't carry the chosen entity).
